# Tool reference

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:tools` from the tool definitions. Do not edit by hand. -->

71 tools. Which ones a client sees depends on `SEVDESK_TOOLSETS` and `SEVDESK_ALLOW` (see the README); tools above the enabled tiers are never listed.

Tiers:

- `read`: reads only; changes nothing in sevDesk.
- `write`: creates or changes reversible records (contacts, parts, drafts).
- `commit`: legally binding or hard-to-undo bookkeeping (finalize, book payments, cancel, enshrine); asks a human first.
- `external`: reaches third parties, e.g. emails a document to a customer; asks a human first.

## Toolset `meta`

### `sevdesk_account_info`

**sevDesk account overview** · tier `read` · read-only, idempotent

Overview of the connected sevDesk account and of this server's permissions. Call it first in a session to orient yourself: it returns the bookkeeping system version (1.0 or 'Update 2.0', which decides whether documents use taxRule or taxType), the VAT regulation (regular or Kleinunternehmer, which decides the tax rules) and chart of accounts, the sevDesk users (Benutzer; their ids are needed as contactPerson on invoices, orders and credit notes) and which permission tiers (read, write, commit, external), toolsets, dry-run and confirmation mode are active, so you know what you may do before you try.

No arguments.

### `sevdesk_document_save`

**Save a document file to disk** · tier `read` · changes state

Save the PDF of an invoice (Rechnung), credit note (Gutschrift) or order (Angebot, Auftragsbestätigung, Lieferschein), or the XML of an e-invoice (E-Rechnung, XRechnung), as a new file in SEVDESK_OUTPUT_DIR, e.g. to archive or attach it. It writes only inside that folder, never overwrites a file (a taken name gets a suffix such as RE-1001-1.pdf) and never changes anything in sevDesk: PDFs are fetched as previews (preventSendBy), so nothing is marked as sent. Every call creates another file, so save each document once. To only look at a file, use sevdesk_invoice_pdf, sevdesk_credit_note_pdf, sevdesk_order_pdf or sevdesk_invoice_xml instead.

| Argument   | Type                                                               | Required | Description                                                                          |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `document` | `invoice_pdf` \| `credit_note_pdf` \| `order_pdf` \| `invoice_xml` | yes      | Which file: invoice_pdf, credit_note_pdf, order_pdf, or invoice_xml (e-invoice XML). |
| `id`       | integer                                                            | yes      | sevDesk id of the document (not its number such as RE-1001).                         |

### `sevdesk_reference_lookup`

**Look up sevDesk ids and codes** · tier `read` · read-only, idempotent

Look up the ids and codes other sevDesk tools need instead of guessing them: tax_rules (Steuerregeln for Update 2.0, e.g. 1 = steuerpflichtig, 11 = Kleinunternehmer §19), contact_categories (Kunde, Lieferant, …), status_codes (Entwurf, offen, bezahlt per document type), document_types (RE, AN, …), users (SevUser), countries (StaticCountry), units (Einheiten), payment_methods (Zahlungsarten) and receipt_guidance (Kontierungshilfe: which booking account (accountDatev) allows which tax rules and tax rates for expense or revenue receipts (Belege); filter with accountNumber, taxRuleId and receiptType, paged with limit/offset). Use query to filter by a case-insensitive substring of names, codes or ids.

| Argument        | Type                                                                                                                                                      | Required | Description                                                                |
| --------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `kind`          | `tax_rules` \| `contact_categories` \| `status_codes` \| `document_types` \| `users` \| `countries` \| `units` \| `payment_methods` \| `receipt_guidance` | yes      | Which list to return.                                                      |
| `query`         | string                                                                                                                                                    | no       | Case-insensitive substring filter on names, codes and ids, e.g. 'reverse'. |
| `accountNumber` | string                                                                                                                                                    | no       | receipt_guidance only: exact account number in the chart of accounts.      |
| `taxRuleId`     | integer                                                                                                                                                   | no       | receipt_guidance only: accounts that allow this tax rule id.               |
| `receiptType`   | `expense` \| `revenue`                                                                                                                                    | no       | receipt_guidance only: accounts for expense or revenue receipts.           |
| `limit`         | integer                                                                                                                                                   | no       | receipt_guidance only: page size, 1–100 (default 25).                      |
| `offset`        | integer                                                                                                                                                   | no       | receipt_guidance only: entries to skip; pass the previous nextOffset.      |

## Toolset `contacts`

### `sevdesk_contact_create`

**Create a sevDesk contact** · tier `write` · changes state, supports `dryRun`

Create a contact (Kontakt anlegen): an organisation (organisationName) or a person (firstName/lastName), as customer (Kunde, default), supplier (Lieferant), partner or prospect, with optional customer number (Kundennummer; default: sevDesk assigns the next free one), USt-IdNr., Steuernummer, Leitweg-ID, billing address (Rechnungsanschrift) and e-mail, phone, website. Tier write. Checks first that no contact with the same name or e-mail exists (allowDuplicate: true creates one anyway) and that the customer number is free. Search with sevdesk_contacts_search before; change it later with sevdesk_contact_update.

| Argument           | Type                                                | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `organisationName` | string                                              | no       | Organisation (company) name. Leave firstName/lastName out for organisations.                                                                                |
| `firstName`        | string                                              | no       | Person: first name (sevDesk field surename). Leave organisationName out.                                                                                    |
| `lastName`         | string                                              | no       | Person: last name (sevDesk field familyname).                                                                                                               |
| `customerNumber`   | string                                              | no       | Kundennummer; must not be used yet.                                                                                                                         |
| `vatNumber`        | string                                              | no       | USt-IdNr. (VAT ID), e.g. DE123456789.                                                                                                                       |
| `taxNumber`        | string                                              | no       | Steuernummer (tax number).                                                                                                                                  |
| `buyerReference`   | string                                              | no       | Leitweg-ID / buyer reference for e-invoices (XRechnung) to public bodies.                                                                                   |
| `category`         | `supplier` \| `customer` \| `partner` \| `prospect` | no       | customer (Kunde), supplier (Lieferant), partner or prospect (Interessent). Default: `"customer"`.                                                           |
| `street`           | string                                              | no       | Street and house number (Straße).                                                                                                                           |
| `zip`              | string                                              | no       | Postal code (PLZ).                                                                                                                                          |
| `city`             | string                                              | no       | City (Ort).                                                                                                                                                 |
| `country`          | string                                              | no       | Country as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. DE (default for a new address), AT, CH.                                                                            |
| `email`            | string                                              | no       | E-mail address.                                                                                                                                             |
| `phone`            | string                                              | no       | Phone number (Telefon).                                                                                                                                     |
| `website`          | string                                              | no       | Website, e.g. https://example.com.                                                                                                                          |
| `allowDuplicate`   | boolean                                             | no       | Create the contact even though one with the same name or e-mail exists. Only after checking that the existing one is really someone else. Default: `false`. |
| `dryRun`           | boolean                                             | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false.    |

### `sevdesk_contact_get`

**Get a sevDesk contact** · tier `read` · read-only, idempotent

Get one contact (Kontakt) by its sevDesk id, with its postal addresses (Adressen, e.g. Rechnungsanschrift) and communication ways (email, phone, website). Use it after sevdesk_contacts_search to check a customer's (Kunde) or supplier's (Lieferant) details, e.g. the billing address or invoice email, before working with their documents. Country ids can be resolved with sevdesk_reference_lookup kind=countries.

| Argument | Type    | Required | Description                                    |
| -------- | ------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `id`     | integer | yes      | Contact id, e.g. from sevdesk_contacts_search. |

### `sevdesk_contact_update`

**Update a sevDesk contact** · tier `write` · changes state, destructive, idempotent, supports `dryRun`

Change a contact (Kontakt ändern): only the fields you give are changed, everything else stays; fields cannot be cleared. Name (organisationName for organisations, firstName/lastName for persons; the kind cannot change), category, Kundennummer (must be free), USt-IdNr., Steuernummer, Leitweg-ID; street/zip/city/country change the billing address (Rechnungsanschrift, or the only address; added when there is none); email/phone/website change the main entry of that type or add one. Tier write. Reads the contact first (sevdesk_contact_get shows the current values) and fails when nothing would change.

| ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`               | integer                                             | yes      | Contact id, e.g. from sevdesk_contacts_search.                                                                                                           |
| `organisationName` | string                                              | no       | Organisation (company) name. Leave firstName/lastName out for organisations.                                                                             |
| `firstName`        | string                                              | no       | Person: first name (sevDesk field surename). Leave organisationName out.                                                                                 |
| `lastName`         | string                                              | no       | Person: last name (sevDesk field familyname).                                                                                                            |
| `customerNumber`   | string                                              | no       | Kundennummer; must not be used yet.                                                                                                                      |
| `vatNumber`        | string                                              | no       | USt-IdNr. (VAT ID), e.g. DE123456789.                                                                                                                    |
| `taxNumber`        | string                                              | no       | Steuernummer (tax number).                                                                                                                               |
| `buyerReference`   | string                                              | no       | Leitweg-ID / buyer reference for e-invoices (XRechnung) to public bodies.                                                                                |
| `category`         | `supplier` \| `customer` \| `partner` \| `prospect` | no       | customer (Kunde), supplier (Lieferant), partner or prospect (Interessent).                                                                               |
| `street`           | string                                              | no       | Street and house number (Straße).                                                                                                                        |
| `zip`              | string                                              | no       | Postal code (PLZ).                                                                                                                                       |
| `city`             | string                                              | no       | City (Ort).                                                                                                                                              |
| `country`          | string                                              | no       | Country as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. DE (default for a new address), AT, CH.                                                                         |
| `email`            | string                                              | no       | E-mail address.                                                                                                                                          |
| `phone`            | string                                              | no       | Phone number (Telefon).                                                                                                                                  |
| `website`          | string                                              | no       | Website, e.g. https://example.com.                                                                                                                       |
| `dryRun`           | boolean                                             | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false. |

### `sevdesk_contacts_next_customer_number`

**Next free sevDesk customer number** · tier `read` · read-only, idempotent

Get the next free customer number (Kundennummer) from the sevDesk number range, to use when creating a contact (Kontakt) so numbering stays consecutive and free of duplicates. Reading it does not reserve it: create the contact right after, and read it again if some time has passed.

No arguments.

### `sevdesk_contacts_search`

**Search sevDesk contacts** · tier `read` · read-only, idempotent

Search contacts (Kontakte) in sevDesk: organisations and persons, such as customers (Kunden), suppliers (Lieferanten), partners and prospects (Interessenten). Filter by name, exact customer number (Kundennummer) and category. sevDesk does the name matching against organisation names and persons' first and last names; if nothing is found, try a shorter or different part of the name. Results are compact and paged (limit/offset, total, hasMore). Use an id with sevdesk_contact_get for addresses, emails and phone numbers.

| Argument         | Type                                                | Required | Description                                                                    |
| ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `query`          | string                                              | no       | Name or part of a name, e.g. 'Musterfirma' or 'Mustermann'.                    |
| `customerNumber` | string                                              | no       | Exact customer number (Kundennummer), e.g. 'K-1001'.                           |
| `category`       | `supplier` \| `customer` \| `partner` \| `prospect` | no       | customer (Kunde), supplier (Lieferant), partner or prospect (Interessent).     |
| `limit`          | integer                                             | no       | Page size, 1–100. Default: `25`.                                               |
| `offset`         | integer                                             | no       | Rows to skip, for paging: pass the previous result's nextOffset. Default: `0`. |

## Toolset `invoices`

### `sevdesk_invoice_book_payment`

**Book a payment on a sevDesk invoice** · tier `commit` · changes state, destructive, supports `dryRun`, asks the user to confirm

Book a payment on an invoice (Zahlung buchen, Zahlungseingang): amount (gross, positive), date (default today), check account (Zahlungskonto, sevdesk_bank_accounts_list) and, for an imported bank payment, its transactionId (sevdesk_transactions_list, status created) so the transaction is linked instead of counted twice. Bank accounts fed by imports need it. Refuses more than the open amount (gross minus paid) unless paymentType reminder_charges or other_difference says the extra is intended; cash_discount (Skonto) and bank_fees settle the invoice with less. Open or partially paid invoices only. Commit tier: asks a human to confirm the preview; dryRun only previews. Undo: sevdesk_invoice_reset to open.

| Argument         | Type                                                                                    | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`             | integer                                                                                 | yes      | Invoice id (not the invoice number), e.g. from sevdesk_invoices_list.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `amount`         | string \| number                                                                        | yes      | Amount received, gross, positive, in the invoice's currency, e.g. "119.00" (at most 2 decimals).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `date`           | string                                                                                  | no       | Booking date (Zahlungsdatum), YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today (Berlin).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `checkAccountId` | integer                                                                                 | yes      | Check account (Zahlungskonto) the money moved on, from sevdesk_bank_accounts_list.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `transactionId`  | integer                                                                                 | no       | Imported bank transaction (Umsatz) to link, from sevdesk_transactions_list (status created, same account). Without it sevDesk creates a new transaction (offline and cash accounts only).                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `paymentType`    | `payment` \| `cash_discount` \| `bank_fees` \| `other_difference` \| `reminder_charges` | no       | payment (default): all of the open amount or a part of it. cash_discount: less than the open amount, the rest is written off as Skonto. bank_fees: less, the rest written off as bank fees (Geldverkehrskosten). other_difference: more or less than the open amount for another reason; the document is settled. reminder_charges: more than the open amount, the extra booked as reminder charges (Mahngebühren). |
| `dryRun`         | boolean                                                                                 | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |

### `sevdesk_invoice_cancel`

**Cancel a sevDesk invoice** · tier `commit` · changes state, destructive, supports `dryRun`, asks the user to confirm

Cancel an invoice (Rechnung stornieren, Storno): sevDesk creates a cancellation invoice (Stornorechnung, type SR) with the negated amounts, already marked as paid, that offsets the original; both stay in the books. Only open, unpaid invoices of type RE, AR, TR or ER (not drafts, reminders or cancellations); for a paid or partially paid invoice create a credit note with sevdesk_credit_note_create_from_invoice. Commit tier: asks a human to confirm the preview; dryRun only previews. Cannot be undone. Returns both invoices; send the cancellation to the customer with sevdesk_invoice_send_email (its id).

| Argument | Type    | Required | Description                                                                                                                                              |
| -------- | ------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`     | integer | yes      | Invoice id (not the invoice number), e.g. from sevdesk_invoices_list.                                                                                    |
| `dryRun` | boolean | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false. |

### `sevdesk_invoice_create_draft`

**Create a draft invoice** · tier `write` · changes state, supports `dryRun`

Create a draft invoice (Rechnungsentwurf, type RE) for a contact with its positions (Positionen). Tier write: it only creates a draft. Nothing is sent to the customer, no invoice number is assigned (sevDesk does that when the invoice is finalized) and nothing is booked. Defaults: today's date, delivery date = invoice date, net prices, EUR, the contact's invoice address, the account's only user as contact person (several users: pass contactPersonId), and the tax rule follows the account: 1 for regular VAT (rates 0/7/19 %), 11 for Kleinunternehmer (0 %). Rules that do not fit the account and rates the rule does not allow are refused before anything is sent; the preview warns about a possible duplicate. dryRun previews without saving. Before: sevdesk_contacts_search for contactId. After: sevdesk_invoice_update_draft to change it, sevdesk_invoice_pdf to look at it, sevdesk_invoice_finalize to make it binding.

| Argument            | Type             | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| ------------------- | ---------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `contactId`         | integer          | yes      | Customer contact id (Kontakt), from sevdesk_contacts_search.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `positions`         | object[]         | yes      | Positionen in printed order; prices per priceMode.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `date`              | string           | no       | Rechnungsdatum, YYYY-MM-DD; default today (Europe/Berlin).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `deliveryDate`      | string           | no       | Delivery or service date (Liefer-/Leistungsdatum), YYYY-MM-DD; default the document date.                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `deliveryDateUntil` | string           | no       | End of the delivery period (Leistungszeitraum bis), YYYY-MM-DD.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `timeToPay`         | integer          | no       | Zahlungsziel in days, e.g. 14.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `priceMode`         | `net` \| `gross` | no       | Whether position unit prices are net (netto, the default for new drafts) or gross (brutto). Sets sevDesk's showNet.                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `taxRule`           | integer          | no       | Tax rule (Steuerregel) id: 1 taxable domestic revenue (default), 2 exports, 3 intra-EU supplies, 4 tax-exempt §4, 5 reverse charge §13b, 11 Kleinunternehmer §19, 17 not taxable in Germany, 18–20 One-Stop-Shop, 21 reverse charge for EU services. Details: sevdesk_reference_lookup kind=tax_rules. |
| `taxText`           | string           | no       | Tax note printed on the document; default: the tax rule's German name.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `currency`          | string           | no       | ISO 4217 currency code (Währung); default EUR.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `header`            | string           | no       | Document title (Betreff); default "Rechnung".                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `headText`          | string           | no       | Intro text above the positions (Kopftext); simple HTML allowed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `footText`          | string           | no       | Closing text below the positions (Fußtext); simple HTML allowed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `contactPersonId`   | integer          | no       | sevDesk user (SevUser) shown as contact person (Ansprechpartner). Required only when the account has several users: sevdesk_reference_lookup kind=users lists them.                                                                                                                                    |
| `addressName`       | string           | no       | Recipient name as printed. Address fields replace the matching parts of the contact's invoice address (new drafts) or of the stored address (updates); the rest is kept.                                                                                                                               |
| `addressStreet`     | string           | no       | Street and number.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `addressZip`        | string           | no       | Postcode (PLZ).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `addressCity`       | string           | no       | City (Ort).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `addressCountry`    | string           | no       | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the address, e.g. DE, AT, CH; default: the country of the address it changes, else DE.                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `dryRun`            | boolean          | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false.                                                                                                                                               |

### `sevdesk_invoice_create_reminder`

**Create a sevDesk payment reminder** · tier `write` · changes state, supports `dryRun`

Create a payment reminder draft (Mahnung / Zahlungserinnerung, invoice type MA) for an overdue invoice: open or partially paid, due date passed, not a draft, Storno or Mahnung itself. Nothing is sent: finalize or email the reminder afterwards with sevdesk_invoice_finalize or sevdesk_invoice_send_email. No reminder fee (Mahngebühr) on Update 2.0. Refuses when an unsent reminder draft for the invoice exists (allowDuplicate overrides). Tier write. Find overdue invoices with sevdesk_invoices_list overdueOnly.

| Argument         | Type    | Required | Description                                                                                                                                              |
| ---------------- | ------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `invoiceId`      | integer | yes      | Id of the overdue invoice (not its number), e.g. from sevdesk_invoices_list.                                                                             |
| `allowDuplicate` | boolean | no       | Create it even though an unsent reminder draft for this invoice exists. Default: `false`.                                                                |
| `dryRun`         | boolean | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false. |

### `sevdesk_invoice_einvoice_preflight`

**Check an invoice for e-invoice readiness** · tier `read` · read-only, idempotent

Check whether an outgoing invoice (Rechnung) can go out as an e-invoice (E-Rechnung: XRechnung / ZUGFeRD) before finalizing it: your company data (USt-IdNr./Steuernummer, address, IBAN, BIC, e-mail, phone), the customer (name, address, country, e-mail, buyer reference / Leitweg-ID for public authorities, USt-IdNr. for reverse charge and intra-EU supplies), Leistungsdatum, Zahlungsziel, payment method, unit codes of the positions and the tax rule (One-Stop-Shop rules 18–20 are not supported). For a finalized invoice it also reads the XML sevDesk generated and checks it against EN 16931 rules. Read only. Returns ready plus problems and warnings, each with the field and the tool that fixes it (sevdesk_invoice_update_draft, sevdesk_contact_update). Before: sevdesk_invoice_get. After: sevdesk_invoice_finalize.

| Argument | Type    | Required | Description                                                           |
| -------- | ------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`     | integer | yes      | Invoice id (not the invoice number), e.g. from sevdesk_invoices_list. |

### `sevdesk_invoice_enshrine`

**Enshrine a sevDesk invoice** · tier `commit` · changes state, destructive, supports `dryRun`, asks the user to confirm

Enshrine an invoice (Rechnung festschreiben, GoBD): lock it permanently so it can never be changed, deleted or reset to draft again; corrections then need a cancellation (sevdesk_invoice_cancel) or a credit note. Irreversible. Payments can still be booked. Only finalized invoices (status open 200 or later) that are not enshrined yet. Commit tier: asks a human to confirm the preview, with an irreversibility warning; dryRun only previews. Before: sevdesk_invoice_get (check it is final).

| Argument | Type    | Required | Description                                                                                                                                              |
| -------- | ------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`     | integer | yes      | Invoice id (not the invoice number), e.g. from sevdesk_invoices_list.                                                                                    |
| `dryRun` | boolean | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false. |

### `sevdesk_invoice_finalize`

**Finalize a sevDesk invoice** · tier `commit` · changes state, destructive, supports `dryRun`, asks the user to confirm

Finalize a draft invoice (Rechnung fertigstellen): sevDesk marks it as sent, assigns its final invoice number and books it, so it becomes legally binding (draft 100 → open 200). Nothing is sent to the customer: sentVia only records how you send it. To email it through sevDesk use sevdesk_invoice_send_email instead (that finalizes too). Commit tier: asks a human to confirm the shown preview; dryRun only previews. Drafts only (create one with sevdesk_invoice_create_draft). Next: sevdesk_invoice_pdf, sevdesk_invoice_book_payment (Zahlung buchen), sevdesk_invoice_enshrine (festschreiben).

| Argument  | Type                                               | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| --------- | -------------------------------------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`      | integer                                            | yes      | Invoice id (not the invoice number), e.g. from sevdesk_invoices_list.                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `sentVia` | `pdf_download` \| `post` \| `print` \| `own_email` | no       | How the document is or was sent, recorded as its send type: pdf_download (VPDF, default: PDF downloaded and sent your own way), post (VP, Briefversand), print (VPR, printed and handed over), own_email (VM, emailed outside sevDesk). |
| `dryRun`  | boolean                                            | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false.                                                                                |

### `sevdesk_invoice_get`

**Get a sevDesk invoice** · tier `read` · read-only, idempotent

Get one invoice (Rechnung) by its sevDesk id with its positions (Positionen: name, quantity, unit, unit price net/gross, tax rate, discount, sums), totals (net, Umsatzsteuer, gross; EUR and document currency for foreign-currency invoices), tax rule (Steuerregel), recipient address, payment terms (Zahlungsziel, Skonto), delivery date (Leistungsdatum), paid amount, the order it was created from (origin; open it with sevdesk_order_get), the invoice a cancellation (SR) cancels and dunning data (Mahnung). Use it after sevdesk_invoices_list. Contact details: sevdesk_contact_get.

| Argument | Type    | Required | Description                                                           |
| -------- | ------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`     | integer | yes      | Invoice id (not the invoice number), e.g. from sevdesk_invoices_list. |

### `sevdesk_invoice_pdf`

**Get an invoice PDF** · tier `read` · read-only, idempotent

Get the PDF of an invoice (Rechnung, also Stornorechnung or Mahnung), e.g. to show, check or forward it. Read-only preview: it is fetched with preventSendBy, so it never marks the invoice as sent (versendet) or changes its status. The result holds the file's metadata and a resource link; the client loads the file itself via resources/read, its content is never put into the text. To save a copy to disk use sevdesk_document_save (available when SEVDESK_OUTPUT_DIR is set). Find the id with the invoice list tools first. For the XRechnung XML of an e-invoice use sevdesk_invoice_xml.

| Argument | Type    | Required | Description                                                  |
| -------- | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `id`     | integer | yes      | sevDesk id of the document (not its number such as RE-1001). |

### `sevdesk_invoice_reset`

**Reset a sevDesk invoice** · tier `commit` · changes state, destructive, supports `dryRun`, asks the user to confirm

Reset an invoice one step back. to "open" (resetToOpen): a paid or partially paid invoice becomes open again and every booked payment is unlinked (bank transactions return to unbooked; no counter-booking). to "draft" (resetToDraft): an open invoice without payments becomes a draft again and can be edited (sevdesk_invoice_update_draft); not for enshrined (festgeschrieben) invoices. For a paid invoice reset to open first, then to draft. Changing an invoice the customer already received is not allowed bookkeeping: prefer sevdesk_invoice_cancel (Storno) or a credit note then. Not for cancellations (SR) or recurring templates. Commit tier: asks a human to confirm the preview; dryRun only previews.

| Argument | Type              | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                   |
| -------- | ----------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`     | integer           | yes      | Invoice id (not the invoice number), e.g. from sevdesk_invoices_list.                                                                                         |
| `to`     | `draft` \| `open` | yes      | open: unlink all payments of a paid or partially paid document (resetToOpen). draft: turn an open document without payments back into a draft (resetToDraft). |
| `dryRun` | boolean           | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false.      |

### `sevdesk_invoice_send_email`

**Email a sevDesk invoice** · tier `external` · changes state, destructive, reaches third parties, supports `dryRun`, asks the user to confirm

Email an invoice (Rechnung per E-Mail versenden) through sevDesk: sevDesk sends the PDF (or, with attachXml, the e-invoice XML) to the recipients and marks the invoice as sent. A draft is finalized by this (only allowed when the commit tier is enabled too): it gets its final number and becomes legally binding. External tier: the email reaches the customer and cannot be recalled, so a human confirms the preview with every recipient, the subject and the text first; dryRun only previews. Addresses are checked locally; cc/bcc up to 10 each. To only record that you sent it yourself, use sevdesk_invoice_finalize. Before: sevdesk_invoice_get, sevdesk_contact_get (email addresses), sevdesk_invoice_pdf (check the PDF).

| Argument       | Type     | Required | Description                                                                                                                                              |
| -------------- | -------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`           | integer  | yes      | Invoice id (not the invoice number), e.g. from sevdesk_invoices_list.                                                                                    |
| `to`           | string   | yes      | Recipient (Empfänger): one email address.                                                                                                                |
| `cc`           | string[] | no       | Cc recipients, up to 10.                                                                                                                                 |
| `bcc`          | string[] | no       | Bcc recipients, up to 10.                                                                                                                                |
| `subject`      | string   | yes      | Subject (Betreff), one line.                                                                                                                             |
| `text`         | string   | yes      | Email text; simple HTML allowed. sevDesk attaches the document itself.                                                                                   |
| `sendCopyToMe` | boolean  | no       | Also send a copy to the sevDesk user's own address. Defaults to false.                                                                                   |
| `dryRun`       | boolean  | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false. |
| `attachXml`    | boolean  | no       | E-invoices (XRechnung/ZUGFeRD) only: attach the XML instead of the PDF. Defaults to false.                                                               |

### `sevdesk_invoice_update_draft`

**Update a draft invoice** · tier `write` · changes state, destructive, idempotent, supports `dryRun`

Change a draft invoice (Rechnungsentwurf, status draft, type RE). Tier write. Only the fields you give change; everything else keeps its stored value. positions, when given, replace ALL stored positions in one request; leave them out to keep the positions. Changing priceMode needs the positions too (stored prices would be re-read), and a new tax rule must allow every stored rate and fit the account's VAT regulation (regular or Kleinunternehmer). A new contactId also takes that contact's invoice address unless you give an address. Open, paid or enshrined (festgeschrieben) invoices cannot be changed: reset an open one to a draft with sevdesk_invoice_reset first. dryRun shows the changes without saving. Before: sevdesk_invoice_get. After: sevdesk_invoice_pdf, sevdesk_invoice_finalize.

| Argument            | Type             | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                              |
| ------------------- | ---------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `id`                | integer          | yes      | Id of the draft invoice (not its number), e.g. from sevdesk_invoices_list.                                                                                               |
| `positions`         | object[]         | no       | When given, replaces ALL positions; leave out to keep them.                                                                                                              |
| `contactId`         | integer          | no       | Customer contact id (Kontakt), from sevdesk_contacts_search.                                                                                                             |
| `date`              | string           | no       | Rechnungsdatum, YYYY-MM-DD.                                                                                                                                              |
| `deliveryDate`      | string           | no       | Liefer-/Leistungsdatum, YYYY-MM-DD.                                                                                                                                      |
| `deliveryDateUntil` | string           | no       | End of the delivery period (Leistungszeitraum bis), YYYY-MM-DD.                                                                                                          |
| `timeToPay`         | integer          | no       | Zahlungsziel in days, e.g. 14.                                                                                                                                           |
| `priceMode`         | `net` \| `gross` | no       | Net or gross unit prices (showNet). Changing it requires positions too.                                                                                                  |
| `taxRule`           | integer          | no       | New tax rule (Steuerregel) id; see sevdesk_reference_lookup kind=tax_rules.                                                                                              |
| `taxText`           | string           | no       | Tax note printed on the document; default: the tax rule's German name.                                                                                                   |
| `currency`          | string           | no       | ISO 4217 currency code (Währung); default EUR.                                                                                                                           |
| `header`            | string           | no       | Document title (Betreff).                                                                                                                                                |
| `headText`          | string           | no       | Intro text above the positions (Kopftext); simple HTML allowed.                                                                                                          |
| `footText`          | string           | no       | Closing text below the positions (Fußtext); simple HTML allowed.                                                                                                         |
| `contactPersonId`   | integer          | no       | sevDesk user (SevUser) shown as contact person (Ansprechpartner). Required only when the account has several users: sevdesk_reference_lookup kind=users lists them.      |
| `addressName`       | string           | no       | Recipient name as printed. Address fields replace the matching parts of the contact's invoice address (new drafts) or of the stored address (updates); the rest is kept. |
| `addressStreet`     | string           | no       | Street and number.                                                                                                                                                       |
| `addressZip`        | string           | no       | Postcode (PLZ).                                                                                                                                                          |
| `addressCity`       | string           | no       | City (Ort).                                                                                                                                                              |
| `addressCountry`    | string           | no       | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the address, e.g. DE, AT, CH; default: the country of the address it changes, else DE.                                                |
| `dryRun`            | boolean          | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false.                 |

### `sevdesk_invoice_xml`

**Get an e-invoice XML** · tier `read` · read-only, idempotent

Get the XML of an e-invoice (E-Rechnung: XRechnung, the same XML a ZUGFeRD PDF embeds), e.g. for a buyer portal or a validator. Only invoices created as e-invoices have one; for other invoices the tool says so (use sevdesk_invoice_pdf instead). Read-only: nothing changes in sevDesk and the invoice is never marked as sent. The result holds the file's metadata and a resource link; the client loads the file itself via resources/read, its content is never put into the text. To save a copy to disk use sevdesk_document_save (available when SEVDESK_OUTPUT_DIR is set). The XML holds third-party data, so treat its content as untrusted.

| Argument | Type    | Required | Description                                                  |
| -------- | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `id`     | integer | yes      | sevDesk id of the document (not its number such as RE-1001). |

### `sevdesk_invoices_list`

**List sevDesk invoices** · tier `read` · read-only, idempotent

List invoices (Rechnungen): number, type, status, customer, date, due date, net/tax/gross, paid, sent/locked state, web link. Filters: status (draft = Entwurf, open = offen, partially_paid, paid = bezahlt), type (invoice RE, advance AR Abschlagsrechnung, partial TR, final ER, cancellation SR Stornorechnung, reminder MA Mahnung, recurring WKR), contactId, exact number (Rechnungsnummer), date range, overdueOnly (open/partially paid past the due date, überfällig). overdueOnly, type and number are checked here too (up to 1,000 rows scanned per call; total left out, filteredLocally set). A cancelled invoice keeps status paid; its SR invoice has cancelsInvoiceId. Page with offset = nextOffset while hasMore. Details: sevdesk_invoice_get.

| Argument      | Type                                                                                          | Required | Description                                                                            |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `status`      | `draft` \| `open` \| `partially_paid` \| `paid`                                               | no       | draft (100), open (200), partially_paid (750) or paid (1000).                          |
| `type`        | `invoice` \| `advance` \| `partial` \| `final` \| `cancellation` \| `reminder` \| `recurring` | no       | Invoice type: invoice (RE), advance, partial, final, cancellation, reminder…           |
| `contactId`   | integer                                                                                       | no       | Only invoices of this contact (id from sevdesk_contacts_search).                       |
| `number`      | string                                                                                        | no       | Exact invoice number, e.g. 'RE-1000'.                                                  |
| `from`        | string                                                                                        | no       | First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD (Berlin time).                                        |
| `to`          | string                                                                                        | no       | Last day to include, YYYY-MM-DD (Berlin time).                                         |
| `overdueOnly` | boolean                                                                                       | no       | Only open/partially paid invoices past their due date (Berlin time). Default: `false`. |
| `limit`       | integer                                                                                       | no       | Page size, 1–100. Default: `25`.                                                       |
| `offset`      | integer                                                                                       | no       | Rows to skip, for paging: pass the previous result's nextOffset. Default: `0`.         |

## Toolset `credit-notes`

### `sevdesk_credit_note_book_payment`

**Book a payment on a sevDesk credit note** · tier `commit` · changes state, destructive, supports `dryRun`, asks the user to confirm

Book a payout on a credit note (Gutschrift auszahlen, Zahlungsausgang): amount (gross, positive; sent to sevDesk as money out), date (default today), check account (Zahlungskonto, sevdesk_bank_accounts_list) and, for an imported bank payment, its transactionId (sevdesk_transactions_list, status created) so the transaction is linked instead of counted twice. Bank accounts fed by imports need it. Refuses more than the open amount unless paymentType other_difference says the extra is intended. Open credit notes only (sevDesk reports no paid amount for partially paid ones). Commit tier: asks a human to confirm the preview; dryRun only previews. Undo: sevdesk_credit_note_reset to open.

| Argument         | Type                                                              | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`             | integer                                                           | yes      | Credit note id (not the credit note number), e.g. from sevdesk_credit_notes_list.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `amount`         | string \| number                                                  | yes      | Amount paid out, gross, positive, in the credit note's currency, e.g. "119.00" (at most 2 decimals).                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `date`           | string                                                            | no       | Booking date (Zahlungsdatum), YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today (Berlin).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `checkAccountId` | integer                                                           | yes      | Check account (Zahlungskonto) the money moved on, from sevdesk_bank_accounts_list.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `transactionId`  | integer                                                           | no       | Imported bank transaction (Umsatz) to link, from sevdesk_transactions_list (status created, same account). Without it sevDesk creates a new transaction (offline and cash accounts only).                                                                                                                         |
| `paymentType`    | `payment` \| `cash_discount` \| `bank_fees` \| `other_difference` | no       | payment (default): all of the open amount or a part of it. cash_discount: less than the open amount, the rest is written off as Skonto. bank_fees: less, the rest written off as bank fees (Geldverkehrskosten). other_difference: more or less than the open amount for another reason; the document is settled. |
| `dryRun`         | boolean                                                           | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false.                                                                                                                                                          |

### `sevdesk_credit_note_create_draft`

**Create a draft credit note** · tier `write` · changes state, supports `dryRun`

Create a draft credit note (Gutschrift) for a contact with its positions. Tier write: it only creates a draft; nothing is sent or booked. Saving reserves the next number of sevDesk's number range (shown in the preview). bookingCategory is required: underachievement (Minderleistung) reduces a finalized invoice of the same contact given as sourceInvoiceId (not cancelled; refused when a credit note for it exists unless allowDuplicate), and every rate must be one of that invoice's rates; provision (Provisionsgutschrift) uses tax rule 9; royalty_assigned/_unassigned (Lizenzen) are not verified live yet. To credit a whole invoice use sevdesk_credit_note_create_from_invoice instead. Defaults: today, net prices, EUR (or the invoice's currency), the contact's invoice address, the account's only user as contact person, tax rule 1 (11 on a Kleinunternehmer account). dryRun previews without saving. After: sevdesk_credit_note_pdf, sevdesk_credit_note_finalize.

| Argument            | Type                                                                            | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `contactId`         | integer                                                                         | yes      | Customer contact id (Kontakt), from sevdesk_contacts_search.                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `bookingCategory`   | `underachievement` \| `provision` \| `royalty_assigned` \| `royalty_unassigned` | yes      | Buchungskategorie: underachievement (Minderleistung: reduces an issued invoice, needs sourceInvoiceId), provision (Provisionsgutschrift, tax rule 9), royalty_assigned or royalty_unassigned (Lizenzgebühren).                               |
| `sourceInvoiceId`   | integer                                                                         | no       | underachievement only: id of the finalized invoice this credit note reduces (refSrcInvoice).                                                                                                                                                 |
| `allowDuplicate`    | boolean                                                                         | no       | underachievement only: create it even though a credit note for the source invoice exists (e.g. a second partial refund). Default false.                                                                                                      |
| `positions`         | object[]                                                                        | yes      | Positionen in printed order; prices per priceMode.                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `date`              | string                                                                          | no       | Gutschriftsdatum, YYYY-MM-DD; default today (Europe/Berlin).                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `deliveryDate`      | string                                                                          | no       | Delivery or service date (Liefer-/Leistungsdatum), YYYY-MM-DD; default the document date.                                                                                                                                                    |
| `deliveryDateUntil` | string                                                                          | no       | End of the delivery period (Leistungszeitraum bis), YYYY-MM-DD.                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `priceMode`         | `net` \| `gross`                                                                | no       | Whether position unit prices are net (netto, the default for new drafts) or gross (brutto). Sets sevDesk's showNet.                                                                                                                          |
| `taxRule`           | integer                                                                         | no       | Tax rule (Steuerregel) id. Default: the source invoice's rule (underachievement), 9 (provision; 10 on a Kleinunternehmer account) or the account's: 1 for regular VAT, 11 for Kleinunternehmer. See sevdesk_reference_lookup kind=tax_rules. |
| `taxText`           | string                                                                          | no       | Tax note printed on the document; default: the tax rule's German name.                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `currency`          | string                                                                          | no       | ISO 4217 code; default EUR or the source invoice's currency.                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `header`            | string                                                                          | no       | Document title (Betreff); default "Gutschrift".                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `headText`          | string                                                                          | no       | Intro text above the positions (Kopftext); simple HTML allowed.                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `footText`          | string                                                                          | no       | Closing text below the positions (Fußtext); simple HTML allowed.                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `contactPersonId`   | integer                                                                         | no       | sevDesk user (SevUser) shown as contact person (Ansprechpartner). Required only when the account has several users: sevdesk_reference_lookup kind=users lists them.                                                                          |
| `addressName`       | string                                                                          | no       | Recipient name as printed. Address fields replace the matching parts of the contact's invoice address (new drafts) or of the stored address (updates); the rest is kept.                                                                     |
| `addressStreet`     | string                                                                          | no       | Street and number.                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `addressZip`        | string                                                                          | no       | Postcode (PLZ).                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `addressCity`       | string                                                                          | no       | City (Ort).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `addressCountry`    | string                                                                          | no       | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the address, e.g. DE, AT, CH; default: the country of the address it changes, else DE.                                                                                                                    |
| `dryRun`            | boolean                                                                         | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false.                                                                                     |

### `sevdesk_credit_note_create_from_invoice`

**Create a credit note from a sevDesk invoice** · tier `write` · changes state, supports `dryRun`

Create a credit note draft (Gutschrift / Rechnungskorrektur) from a finalized invoice (open, partially paid or paid; not a draft, Storno, Mahnung or Abo template, and not cancelled) with all its positions: the way to correct or refund a paid invoice. For an unpaid invoice that should be voided completely, cancel it instead (sevdesk_invoice_cancel). Refuses when a credit note for the invoice exists (allowDuplicate overrides, e.g. a second partial refund). Tier write. Afterwards sevDesk's credit note counter is moved past the new draft's number (sevDesk does not do that itself). Then check it with sevdesk_credit_note_get and finalize it with sevdesk_credit_note_finalize.

| Argument         | Type    | Required | Description                                                                                                                                              |
| ---------------- | ------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `invoiceId`      | integer | yes      | Invoice id (not its number), e.g. from sevdesk_invoices_list.                                                                                            |
| `allowDuplicate` | boolean | no       | Create it even though a credit note from this invoice exists. Default: `false`.                                                                          |
| `dryRun`         | boolean | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false. |

### `sevdesk_credit_note_enshrine`

**Enshrine a sevDesk credit note** · tier `commit` · changes state, destructive, supports `dryRun`, asks the user to confirm

Enshrine a credit note (Gutschrift festschreiben, GoBD): lock it permanently so it can never be reset to draft or deleted again. Irreversible. Payments can still be booked. Only finalized credit notes (status open 200 or later) that are not enshrined yet. Commit tier: asks a human to confirm the preview, with an irreversibility warning; dryRun only previews. Before: sevdesk_credit_note_get (check it is final).

| Argument | Type    | Required | Description                                                                                                                                              |
| -------- | ------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`     | integer | yes      | Credit note id (not the credit note number), e.g. from sevdesk_credit_notes_list.                                                                        |
| `dryRun` | boolean | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false. |

### `sevdesk_credit_note_finalize`

**Finalize a sevDesk credit note** · tier `commit` · changes state, destructive, supports `dryRun`, asks the user to confirm

Finalize a draft credit note (Gutschrift fertigstellen): sevDesk marks it as sent and books it (draft 100 → open 200) under the number the draft carries. Nothing is sent to the customer: sentVia only records how you send it. To email it through sevDesk use sevdesk_credit_note_send_email instead. Commit tier: asks a human to confirm the shown preview; dryRun only previews. Drafts with a number only (sevDesk can fail half-way on a draft without one; sevdesk_credit_note_create_draft assigns one). Next: sevdesk_credit_note_book_payment (Auszahlung buchen), sevdesk_credit_note_enshrine.

| Argument  | Type                                               | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| --------- | -------------------------------------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`      | integer                                            | yes      | Credit note id (not the credit note number), e.g. from sevdesk_credit_notes_list.                                                                                                                                                       |
| `sentVia` | `pdf_download` \| `post` \| `print` \| `own_email` | no       | How the document is or was sent, recorded as its send type: pdf_download (VPDF, default: PDF downloaded and sent your own way), post (VP, Briefversand), print (VPR, printed and handed over), own_email (VM, emailed outside sevDesk). |
| `dryRun`  | boolean                                            | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false.                                                                                |

### `sevdesk_credit_note_get`

Get one credit note (Gutschrift) by its sevDesk id with its positions (name, quantity, unit, unit price net/gross, tax rate, sums), totals (net, Umsatzsteuer, gross), tax rule (Steuerregel), booking category, the invoice or voucher it refers to (sourceInvoiceId, sourceVoucherId), recipient address and delivery date. Use it after sevdesk_credit_notes_list; open the source invoice with sevdesk_invoice_get.

| `id`     | integer | yes      | Credit note id (not its number), e.g. from sevdesk_credit_notes_list. |
