### `sevdesk_credit_notes_list`

**List sevDesk credit notes** · tier `read` · read-only, idempotent

List credit notes (Gutschriften) with compact rows: number, status, contact, date, net/tax/gross, booking category (e.g. UNDERACHIEVEMENT = Minderleistung, PROVISION) and the invoice they refer to (sourceInvoiceId). Filter by status (draft = Entwurf, open, partially_paid, paid), contactId, exact credit note number (Gutschriftsnummer) and date range. Page with offset = nextOffset while hasMore. Details and positions: sevdesk_credit_note_get; the source invoice: sevdesk_invoice_get.

| Argument    | Type                                            | Required | Description                                                                    |
| ----------- | ----------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `status`    | `draft` \| `open` \| `partially_paid` \| `paid` | no       | draft (100), open (200), partially_paid (750) or paid (1000).                  |
| `contactId` | integer                                         | no       | Only credit notes of this contact.                                             |
| `number`    | string                                          | no       | Exact credit note number, e.g. 'GU-1000'.                                      |
| `from`      | string                                          | no       | First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD (Berlin time).                                |
| `to`        | string                                          | no       | Last day to include, YYYY-MM-DD (Berlin time).                                 |
| `limit`     | integer                                         | no       | Page size, 1–100. Default: `25`.                                               |
| `offset`    | integer                                         | no       | Rows to skip, for paging: pass the previous result's nextOffset. Default: `0`. |

## Toolset `orders`

### `sevdesk_order_create_draft`

**Create a draft order** · tier `write` · changes state, supports `dryRun`

Create a draft offer (Angebot, AN), order confirmation (Auftragsbestätigung, AB) or delivery note (Lieferschein, LI) for a contact with its positions (Positionen; offers may have optional positions). Tier write: it only creates a draft; nothing is sent to the customer. Its number comes from sevDesk's number range: the preview shows the next one, saving reserves it. Defaults: today's date, net prices, EUR, the contact's invoice address, the account's only user as contact person (several users: pass contactPersonId), and the tax rule follows the account: 1 for regular VAT (0/7/19 %), 11 for Kleinunternehmer (0 %). Rules that do not fit the account and rates the rule does not allow are refused before anything is sent; the preview warns about a possible duplicate. dryRun previews without saving. Before: sevdesk_contacts_search. After: sevdesk_order_update_draft, sevdesk_order_pdf, sevdesk_order_finalize, sevdesk_order_to_invoice.

| Argument          | Type                                               | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| ----------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `contactId`       | integer                                            | yes      | Customer contact id (Kontakt), from sevdesk_contacts_search.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `orderType`       | `offer` \| `order_confirmation` \| `delivery_note` | yes      | offer (Angebot, AN), order_confirmation (Auftragsbestätigung, AB) or delivery_note (Lieferschein, LI).                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `positions`       | object[]                                           | yes      | Positionen in printed order; prices per priceMode.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `date`            | string                                             | no       | Angebots-/Auftragsdatum, YYYY-MM-DD; default today (Berlin).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `priceMode`       | `net` \| `gross`                                   | no       | Whether position unit prices are net (netto, the default for new drafts) or gross (brutto). Sets sevDesk's showNet.                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `taxRule`         | integer                                            | no       | Tax rule (Steuerregel) id: 1 taxable domestic revenue (default), 2 exports, 3 intra-EU supplies, 4 tax-exempt §4, 5 reverse charge §13b, 11 Kleinunternehmer §19, 17 not taxable in Germany, 18–20 One-Stop-Shop, 21 reverse charge for EU services. Details: sevdesk_reference_lookup kind=tax_rules. |
| `taxText`         | string                                             | no       | Tax note printed on the document; default: the tax rule's German name.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `currency`        | string                                             | no       | ISO 4217 currency code (Währung); default EUR.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `header`          | string                                             | no       | Document title (Betreff); default "Angebot", "Auftragsbestätigung" or "Lieferschein".                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `headText`        | string                                             | no       | Intro text above the positions (Kopftext); simple HTML allowed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `footText`        | string                                             | no       | Closing text below the positions (Fußtext); simple HTML allowed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `paymentTerms`    | string                                             | no       | Zahlungsbedingungen as printed on the document.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `deliveryTerms`   | string                                             | no       | Lieferbedingungen as printed on the document.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `contactPersonId` | integer                                            | no       | sevDesk user (SevUser) shown as contact person (Ansprechpartner). Required only when the account has several users: sevdesk_reference_lookup kind=users lists them.                                                                                                                                    |
| `addressName`     | string                                             | no       | Recipient name as printed. Address fields replace the matching parts of the contact's invoice address (new drafts) or of the stored address (updates); the rest is kept.                                                                                                                               |
| `addressStreet`   | string                                             | no       | Street and number.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `addressZip`      | string                                             | no       | Postcode (PLZ).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `addressCity`     | string                                             | no       | City (Ort).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `addressCountry`  | string                                             | no       | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the address, e.g. DE, AT, CH; default: the country of the address it changes, else DE.                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `dryRun`          | boolean                                            | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false.                                                                                                                                               |

### `sevdesk_order_finalize`

**Finalize a sevDesk order** · tier `commit` · changes state, destructive, supports `dryRun`, asks the user to confirm

Finalize a draft order (Angebot, Auftragsbestätigung or Lieferschein fertigstellen): sevDesk marks it as sent and assigns its final number (draft 100 → sent 200). Nothing is sent to the customer: sentVia only records how you send it. To email it through sevDesk use sevdesk_order_send_email instead. Commit tier: asks a human to confirm the shown preview; dryRun only previews. Drafts only (create one with sevdesk_order_create_draft). Next: sevdesk_order_pdf, sevdesk_order_to_invoice.

| Argument  | Type                                               | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| --------- | -------------------------------------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`      | integer                                            | yes      | Order id (not the order number), e.g. from sevdesk_orders_list.                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `sentVia` | `pdf_download` \| `post` \| `print` \| `own_email` | no       | How the document is or was sent, recorded as its send type: pdf_download (VPDF, default: PDF downloaded and sent your own way), post (VP, Briefversand), print (VPR, printed and handed over), own_email (VM, emailed outside sevDesk). |
| `dryRun`  | boolean                                            | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false.                                                                                |

### `sevdesk_order_get`

**Get a sevDesk order** · tier `read` · read-only, idempotent

Get one order by its sevDesk id: an offer (Angebot), order confirmation (Auftragsbestätigung) or delivery note (Lieferschein), with its positions (name, quantity, unit, unit price net/gross, tax rate, discount, optional positions), totals (net, Umsatzsteuer, gross), tax rule, payment and delivery terms, recipient address, the order it was created from (origin) and related documents such as the invoices created from it (open them with sevdesk_invoice_get). Use it after sevdesk_orders_list.

| Argument | Type    | Required | Description                                               |
| -------- | ------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`     | integer | yes      | Order id (not its number), e.g. from sevdesk_orders_list. |

### `sevdesk_order_pdf`

**Get an order PDF** · tier `read` · read-only, idempotent

Get the PDF of an order: Angebot (AN, quote), Auftragsbestätigung (AB) or Lieferschein (LI), e.g. to show, check or forward it. Read-only preview: it is fetched with preventSendBy, so it never marks the order as sent or commits it, and its status and editability stay as they are. The result holds the file's metadata and a resource link; the client loads the file itself via resources/read, its content is never put into the text. To save a copy to disk use sevdesk_document_save (available when SEVDESK_OUTPUT_DIR is set). Find the id with the order list tools first.

| Argument | Type    | Required | Description                                                  |
| -------- | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `id`     | integer | yes      | sevDesk id of the document (not its number such as RE-1001). |

### `sevdesk_order_send_email`

**Email a sevDesk order** · tier `external` · changes state, destructive, reaches third parties, supports `dryRun`, asks the user to confirm

Email an order (Angebot, Auftragsbestätigung or Lieferschein per E-Mail versenden) through sevDesk: sevDesk sends the PDF to the recipients and marks the order as sent; a draft is finalized by this and gets its final number (only allowed when the commit tier is enabled too). External tier: the email reaches the customer and cannot be recalled, so a human confirms the preview with every recipient, the subject and the text first; dryRun only previews. Addresses are checked locally; cc/bcc up to 10 each. To only record that you sent it yourself, use sevdesk_order_finalize. Before: sevdesk_order_get, sevdesk_contact_get, sevdesk_order_pdf.

| Argument       | Type     | Required | Description                                                                                                                                              |
| -------------- | -------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`           | integer  | yes      | Order id (not the order number), e.g. from sevdesk_orders_list.                                                                                          |
| `to`           | string   | yes      | Recipient (Empfänger): one email address.                                                                                                                |
| `cc`           | string[] | no       | Cc recipients, up to 10.                                                                                                                                 |
| `bcc`          | string[] | no       | Bcc recipients, up to 10.                                                                                                                                |
| `subject`      | string   | yes      | Subject (Betreff), one line.                                                                                                                             |
| `text`         | string   | yes      | Email text; simple HTML allowed. sevDesk attaches the document itself.                                                                                   |
| `sendCopyToMe` | boolean  | no       | Also send a copy to the sevDesk user's own address. Defaults to false.                                                                                   |
| `dryRun`       | boolean  | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false. |

### `sevdesk_order_to_invoice`

**Create an invoice from a sevDesk order** · tier `write` · changes state, supports `dryRun`

Create an invoice draft (Rechnung) from an offer (Angebot, AN) or order confirmation (Auftragsbestätigung, AB) with its positions: the whole order (mode full), or a partial invoice (Teilrechnung, mode partial) or advance invoice (Abschlagsrechnung, mode advance) for an amount as percentage, net or gross. The order must be sent, accepted or partially invoiced, not a draft, rejected or fully invoiced; partial/advance need tax rule 1 or 11. Refuses when an invoice draft from the order exists (allowDuplicate overrides). Tier write. Then check it with sevdesk_invoice_get and finalize it with sevdesk_invoice_finalize.

| Argument         | Type                             | Required | Description                                                                                                                                              |
| ---------------- | -------------------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `orderId`        | integer                          | yes      | Order id (not its number), e.g. from sevdesk_orders_list.                                                                                                |
| `mode`           | `full` \| `partial` \| `advance` | no       | full: whole order; partial: Teilrechnung; advance: Abschlagsrechnung. Default: `"full"`.                                                                 |
| `amount`         | string \| number                 | no       | partial/advance only: the amount, in the unit of amountType.                                                                                             |
| `amountType`     | `percentage` \| `net` \| `gross` | no       | partial/advance only: percent of the order, or an amount net or gross. Default: `"percentage"`.                                                          |
| `allowDuplicate` | boolean                          | no       | Create it even though an invoice draft from this order exists. Default: `false`.                                                                         |
| `dryRun`         | boolean                          | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false. |

### `sevdesk_order_update_draft`

**Update a draft order** · tier `write` · changes state, destructive, idempotent, supports `dryRun`

Change a draft offer (Angebot), order confirmation (Auftragsbestätigung) or delivery note (Lieferschein). Tier write. Only the fields you give change; everything else keeps its stored value, the type stays. positions, when given, replace ALL stored positions in one request (saveOrder with the order's id); leave them out to keep them. Changing priceMode needs the positions too, and a new tax rule must allow every stored rate and fit the account's VAT regulation (regular or Kleinunternehmer). A new contactId also takes that contact's invoice address unless you give an address. Only drafts can be changed; for a sent offer create a new draft. dryRun shows the changes without saving. Before: sevdesk_order_get. After: sevdesk_order_pdf, sevdesk_order_finalize.

| `positions`       | object[]         | no       | When given, replaces ALL positions; leave out to keep them.                                                                                                              |
| `contactId`       | integer          | no       | Customer contact id (Kontakt), from sevdesk_contacts_search.                                                                                                             |
| `date`            | string           | no       | Angebots-/Auftragsdatum, YYYY-MM-DD.                                                                                                                                     |
| `priceMode`       | `net` \| `gross` | no       | Net or gross unit prices (showNet). Changing it requires positions too.                                                                                                  |
| `taxRule`         | integer          | no       | New tax rule (Steuerregel) id; see sevdesk_reference_lookup kind=tax_rules.                                                                                              |
| `taxText`         | string           | no       | Tax note printed on the document; default: the tax rule's German name.                                                                                                   |
| `currency`        | string           | no       | ISO 4217 currency code (Währung); default EUR.                                                                                                                           |
| `header`          | string           | no       | Document title (Betreff).                                                                                                                                                |
| `headText`        | string           | no       | Intro text above the positions (Kopftext); simple HTML allowed.                                                                                                          |
| `footText`        | string           | no       | Closing text below the positions (Fußtext); simple HTML allowed.                                                                                                         |
| `paymentTerms`    | string           | no       | Zahlungsbedingungen as printed on the document.                                                                                                                          |
| `deliveryTerms`   | string           | no       | Lieferbedingungen as printed on the document.                                                                                                                            |
| `contactPersonId` | integer          | no       | sevDesk user (SevUser) shown as contact person (Ansprechpartner). Required only when the account has several users: sevdesk_reference_lookup kind=users lists them.      |
| `addressName`     | string           | no       | Recipient name as printed. Address fields replace the matching parts of the contact's invoice address (new drafts) or of the stored address (updates); the rest is kept. |
| `addressStreet`   | string           | no       | Street and number.                                                                                                                                                       |
| `addressZip`      | string           | no       | Postcode (PLZ).                                                                                                                                                          |
| `addressCity`     | string           | no       | City (Ort).                                                                                                                                                              |
| `addressCountry`  | string           | no       | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the address, e.g. DE, AT, CH; default: the country of the address it changes, else DE.                                                |
| `dryRun`          | boolean          | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false.                 |

### `sevdesk_orders_list`

**List sevDesk orders** · tier `read` · read-only, idempotent

List orders in sevDesk: offers (Angebote, AN), order confirmations (Auftragsbestätigungen, AB) and delivery notes (Lieferscheine, LI), with compact rows: number, type, status, contact, date, net/tax/gross. Filter by type, status (draft = Entwurf, sent = versendet, rejected = abgelehnt, accepted = angenommen, partially_invoiced, invoiced = berechnet), contactId, exact order number and date range. ## Toolset `vouchers`

### `sevdesk_einvoice_parse`

**Parse a local e-invoice file** · tier `read` · read-only, idempotent

Read a local e-invoice (E-Rechnung) from a folder listed in SEVDESK_FILE_DIRS: an XRechnung (UBL or CII XML) or a ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDF with embedded XML. Returns the EN 16931 data (Lieferant/seller, buyer, Rechnungsnummer, dates, lines, VAT breakdown, totals), rule findings (sums, VAT categories, XRechnung rules) and a suggested voucher (Beleg): Ausgabe or Einnahme, matching sevDesk contacts (by USt-IdNr., IBAN, exact name), tax rule (Steuerregel), one position per VAT rate, Belegnummer and dates. Read only: nothing is sent to sevDesk and no contact is created. A plain PDF receipt without XML is refused: book it with sevdesk_voucher_create_draft and the file. Next: sevdesk_voucher_import_einvoice creates the draft voucher with the file attached.

| Argument | Type   | Required | Description                                                                                                                                       |
| -------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `file`   | string | yes      | The e-invoice file: an absolute path inside one of the SEVDESK_FILE_DIRS folders, or a path relative to one of them, e.g. Rechnungen/RE-4711.xml. |

### `sevdesk_voucher_book_payment`

**Book a payment on a sevDesk voucher** · tier `commit` · changes state, destructive, supports `dryRun`, asks the user to confirm

Book a payment on a voucher (Beleg bezahlen, Zahlung buchen): amount (gross, positive; sent to sevDesk signed as the money moves: an expense voucher (Ausgabe) as money out, a revenue voucher (Einnahme) as money in), date (default today), check account (Zahlungskonto, sevdesk_bank_accounts_list) and, for an imported bank payment, its transactionId (Kontoumsatz, sevdesk_transactions_list, status created, same direction) so the transaction is linked instead of counted twice. Bank accounts fed by imports need it. Refuses more than the open amount unless paymentType other_difference says the extra is intended; cash_discount (Skonto) and bank_fees settle it with less. Open or partially paid vouchers only (finalize a draft first: sevdesk_voucher_finalize). Commit tier: asks a human to confirm the preview; dryRun only previews. Undo: sevdesk_voucher_reset to open.

| Argument         | Type                                                              | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`             | integer                                                           | yes      | Voucher id (not the Belegnummer), e.g. from sevdesk_vouchers_list.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `amount`         | string \| number                                                  | yes      | Amount paid (expense voucher) or received (revenue voucher), gross, positive, in the voucher's currency, e.g. "119.00" (at most 2 decimals).                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `date`           | string                                                            | no       | Booking date (Zahlungsdatum), YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today (Berlin).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `checkAccountId` | integer                                                           | yes      | Check account (Zahlungskonto) the money moved on, from sevdesk_bank_accounts_list.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `transactionId`  | integer                                                           | no       | Imported bank transaction (Umsatz) to link, from sevdesk_transactions_list (status created, same account). Without it sevDesk creates a new transaction (offline and cash accounts only).                                                                                                                         |
| `paymentType`    | `payment` \| `cash_discount` \| `bank_fees` \| `other_difference` | no       | payment (default): all of the open amount or a part of it. cash_discount: less than the open amount, the rest is written off as Skonto. bank_fees: less, the rest written off as bank fees (Geldverkehrskosten). other_difference: more or less than the open amount for another reason; the document is settled. |
| `dryRun`         | boolean                                                           | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false.                                                                                                                                                          |

### `sevdesk_voucher_create_draft`

**Create a draft voucher** · tier `write` · changes state, supports `dryRun`

Create a draft voucher (Beleg, Belegentwurf) for a receipt or supplier invoice (Lieferantenrechnung): kind expense (default) or revenue, supplier (Lieferant: contact or name), Belegnummer, Belegdatum and positions (Belegpositionen) of booking account (Buchungskonto, accountDatevId), amount and tax rate. Optionally attaches the receipt file (PDF/PNG/JPEG from SEVDESK_FILE_DIRS; refused with a hint when that is not set). Tier write: only a draft, nothing is booked. Every account × Steuerregel × rate is checked against sevDesk's ReceiptGuidance first; the tax rule defaults to 9 (or 10 for Kleinunternehmer) for expenses, 1 (or 11) for revenue. Needs sevDesk Update 2.0, EUR. A possible duplicate (same supplier, Belegnummer, date, gross) is refused unless allowDuplicate. dryRun previews. Before: sevdesk_reference_lookup kind=receipt_guidance. After: sevdesk_voucher_finalize.

| Argument            | Type                   | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ------------------- | ---------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `kind`              | `expense` \| `revenue` | no       | expense (Ausgabe, default: a receipt or supplier invoice, money out) or revenue (Einnahme, money in).                                                                                                                                                     |
| `supplierId`        | integer                | no       | Lieferant (supplier; the customer of a revenue voucher) as a contact id from sevdesk_contacts_search. Pass supplierId or supplierName.                                                                                                                    |
| `supplierName`      | string                 | no       | Supplier name as text, when there is no contact (e.g. a petrol station).                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `number`            | string                 | no       | Belegnummer: the receipt's or supplier invoice's own number.                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `date`              | string                 | no       | Belegdatum, YYYY-MM-DD; default today (Berlin).                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `deliveryDate`      | string                 | no       | Leistungsdatum, YYYY-MM-DD; default the voucher date.                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `deliveryDateUntil` | string                 | no       | End of the service period (Leistungszeitraum bis), YYYY-MM-DD.                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `paymentDeadline`   | string                 | no       | Fälligkeit (payment deadline), YYYY-MM-DD.                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `taxRule`           | integer                | no       | Steuerregel id. Default: expense 9 (Vorsteuerabziehbare Aufwendungen), on a Kleinunternehmer account 10; revenue 1, or 11 for Kleinunternehmer. Others: 8, 12–14 (intra-EU, reverse charge), 2–5, 17. Not 18–21. sevdesk_reference_lookup kind=tax_rules. |
| `amountsAre`        | `gross` \| `net`       | no       | Whether position amounts are gross (Brutto, default) or net (Netto).                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `positions`         | object[]               | yes      | Belegpositionen: one per booking account and tax rate.                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `file`              | string                 | no       | Receipt file (Belegbild: PDF, PNG or JPEG, up to 20 MB) inside SEVDESK_FILE_DIRS, absolute or relative to one of those folders. It is uploaded and attached.                                                                                              |
| `allowDuplicate`    | boolean                | no       | Create it although a voucher with the same supplier, Belegnummer, date and gross exists.                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `dryRun`            | boolean                | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false.                                                                                                  |

### `sevdesk_voucher_delete_draft`

**Delete a draft voucher** · tier `commit` · changes state, destructive, idempotent, supports `dryRun`, asks the user to confirm

Delete a draft voucher (Belegentwurf löschen) with its positions, e.g. a duplicate or a wrongly captured receipt. Only drafts (status 50) that are not enshrined (festgeschrieben); booked vouchers stay in the books (reset to draft first with sevdesk_voucher_reset only if that is really intended). Cannot be undone, and an attached receipt may go with it. Commit tier: asks a human to confirm the preview, which names the voucher; dryRun only previews. Before: sevdesk_voucher_get.

| Argument | Type    | Required | Description                                                                                                                                              |
| -------- | ------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`     | integer | yes      | Voucher id (not the Belegnummer), e.g. from sevdesk_vouchers_list.                                                                                       |
| `dryRun` | boolean | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false. |

### `sevdesk_voucher_enshrine`

**Enshrine a sevDesk voucher** · tier `commit` · changes state, destructive, supports `dryRun`, asks the user to confirm

Enshrine a voucher (Beleg festschreiben, GoBD): lock it permanently so it can never be changed, reset to draft or deleted again; corrections then need a new voucher. Irreversible. Only finalized vouchers (status open 100 or later, see sevdesk_voucher_finalize) that are not enshrined yet. Commit tier: asks a human to confirm the preview, with an irreversibility warning; dryRun only previews. Before: sevdesk_voucher_get (check positions, accounts and the attached receipt).

| Argument | Type    | Required | Description                                                                                                                                              |
| -------- | ------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`     | integer | yes      | Voucher id (not the Belegnummer), e.g. from sevdesk_vouchers_list.                                                                                       |
| `dryRun` | boolean | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false. |

### `sevdesk_voucher_finalize`

**Finalize a draft voucher** · tier `commit` · changes state, destructive, supports `dryRun`, asks the user to confirm

Finalize a draft voucher (Beleg verbuchen): status draft 50 → open 100, so it is booked and counts in the books (EÜR, Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldung/UStVA) from now on. Before sending it checks what sevDesk would refuse late: an Update 2.0 tax rule (Steuerregel) that fits the account's VAT regulation, at least one position, and every booking account (Buchungskonto) × rule × rate against the ReceiptGuidance. Commit tier: asks a human to confirm the preview; dryRun only previews. Undo while not enshrined: sevdesk_voucher_reset (to draft). Before: sevdesk_voucher_get. After: sevdesk_voucher_book_payment (Zahlung buchen), sevdesk_voucher_enshrine.

| Argument | Type    | Required | Description                                                                                                                                              |
| -------- | ------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`     | integer | yes      | Voucher id (not the Belegnummer), e.g. from sevdesk_vouchers_list.                                                                                       |
| `dryRun` | boolean | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false. |

### `sevdesk_voucher_get`

**Get a sevDesk voucher** · tier `read` · read-only, idempotent

Get one voucher (Beleg) by its sevDesk id with its positions (Belegpositionen): per position net, tax and gross amount, tax rate and booking account (Buchungskonto: accountDatev id in Update 2.0, accountingType id in legacy 1.0 positions), plus the voucher's tax rule (Steuerregel) or legacy tax type, dates, status and payment direction. Old and new bookkeeping generations are shown per record, also when mixed. Use it after sevdesk_vouchers_list, e.g. to see how a supplier's earlier receipts were booked.

| Argument | Type    | Required | Description                                  |
| -------- | ------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `id`     | integer | yes      | Voucher id, e.g. from sevdesk_vouchers_list. |

### `sevdesk_voucher_import_einvoice`

**Import an e-invoice as a voucher** · tier `write` · changes state, supports `dryRun`

Import a received e-invoice (E-Rechnung: XRechnung XML or ZUGFeRD/Factur-X PDF from SEVDESK_FILE_DIRS) as a draft voucher (Beleg) and attach the original file. Supplier (Lieferant: contact matched by VAT id/IBAN, else the issuer's name), Belegnummer, dates and one position per VAT rate (net amounts) come from the invoice; you give the Buchungskonto (accountDatevId, or accounts per rate). Refused when the invoice's sums or VAT breakdown are unreliable, when the voucher totals would differ from the invoice totals, or when an account × Steuerregel × rate is not allowed (ReceiptGuidance). EUR, Update 2.0. Tier write: only a draft; dryRun previews. Before: sevdesk_einvoice_parse. After: sevdesk_voucher_finalize.

| Argument         | Type     | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                      |
| ---------------- | -------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `file`           | string   | yes      | The e-invoice: an XRechnung XML or a ZUGFeRD/Factur-X PDF inside SEVDESK_FILE_DIRS, absolute or relative to one of those folders. It is attached to the voucher. |
| `accountDatevId` | integer  | no       | Buchungskonto (accountDatev id) for every VAT rate of the invoice; see sevdesk_reference_lookup kind=receipt_guidance.                                           |
| `accounts`       | object[] | no       | A Buchungskonto per VAT rate; wins over accountDatevId for its rate.                                                                                             |
| `supplierId`     | integer  | no       | Lieferant contact id. Default: the contact that matches the issuer's VAT id or IBAN (exactly one), else the issuer's name only; contacts are never created.      |
| `taxRuleId`      | integer  | no       | Steuerregel. Default: derived from the invoice's VAT categories and the account's VAT regulation (e.g. 9, or 10 for Kleinunternehmer).                           |
| `allowDuplicate` | boolean  | no       | Import it although a voucher with the same supplier, number, date and gross exists.                                                                              |
| `dryRun`         | boolean  | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false.         |

### `sevdesk_voucher_reset`

**Reset a sevDesk voucher** · tier `commit` · changes state, destructive, supports `dryRun`, asks the user to confirm

Reset a voucher (Beleg) one step back. to "open" (resetToOpen): a paid or partially paid voucher becomes open (100) again and every booked payment is unlinked (bank transactions return to unbooked; no counter-booking). to "draft" (resetToDraft): an open voucher without payments becomes a draft (50) again and can be changed with sevdesk_voucher_update_draft or deleted with sevdesk_voucher_delete_draft; not for enshrined (festgeschrieben) vouchers. For a paid voucher reset to open first, then to draft. Commit tier: asks a human to confirm the preview; dryRun only previews.

| Argument | Type              | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                   |
| -------- | ----------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`     | integer           | yes      | Voucher id (not the Belegnummer), e.g. from sevdesk_vouchers_list.                                                                                            |
| `to`     | `draft` \| `open` | yes      | open: unlink all payments of a paid or partially paid document (resetToOpen). draft: turn an open document without payments back into a draft (resetToDraft). |
| `dryRun` | boolean           | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false.      |

### `sevdesk_voucher_update_draft`

**Update a draft voucher** · tier `write` · changes state, destructive, supports `dryRun`

Change a draft voucher (Beleg, status draft 50): supplier (Lieferant), Belegnummer, dates, Steuerregel, or replace ALL positions (Belegpositionen) at once, and/or attach a receipt file (PDF/PNG/JPEG from SEVDESK_FILE_DIRS). Fields left out keep their stored values. A new tax rule must fit every position; accounts × rule × rate are checked against sevDesk's ReceiptGuidance before anything is sent. Only drafts that are not enshrined (EUR, Update 2.0); a booked voucher must be reset to draft first (sevdesk_voucher_reset). Tier write; dryRun previews. Before: sevdesk_voucher_get. After: sevdesk_voucher_finalize.

| Argument            | Type             | Required | Description                                                                                                                                              |
| ------------------- | ---------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`                | integer          | yes      | Id of the draft voucher, e.g. from sevdesk_vouchers_list.                                                                                                |
| `supplierId`        | integer          | no       | Lieferant (supplier; the customer of a revenue voucher) as a contact id from sevdesk_contacts_search. Pass supplierId or supplierName.                   |
| `supplierName`      | string           | no       | Supplier name as text, when there is no contact (e.g. a petrol station).                                                                                 |
| `number`            | string           | no       | Belegnummer: the receipt's or supplier invoice's own number.                                                                                             |
| `date`              | string           | no       | Belegdatum, YYYY-MM-DD; default today (Berlin).                                                                                                          |
| `deliveryDate`      | string           | no       | Leistungsdatum, YYYY-MM-DD; default the voucher date.                                                                                                    |
| `deliveryDateUntil` | string           | no       | End of the service period (Leistungszeitraum bis), YYYY-MM-DD.                                                                                           |
| `paymentDeadline`   | string           | no       | Fälligkeit (payment deadline), YYYY-MM-DD.                                                                                                               |
| `taxRule`           | integer          | no       | New Steuerregel id; every position (stored or new) must allow it. See sevdesk_reference_lookup kind=tax_rules.                                           |
| `amountsAre`        | `gross` \| `net` | no       | gross or net position amounts; changing it requires positions too.                                                                                       |
| `positions`         | object[]         | no       | When given, replaces ALL positions; leave out to keep them.                                                                                              |
| `file`              | string           | no       | Receipt file to attach (PDF, PNG or JPEG inside SEVDESK_FILE_DIRS).                                                                                      |
| `dryRun`            | boolean          | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false. |

### `sevdesk_vouchers_list`

**List sevDesk vouchers** · tier `read` · read-only, idempotent

List vouchers (Belege): receipts and supplier invoices (Ausgaben, kind=expense) and other income documents (Einnahmen, kind=revenue). Filter by status (draft = Entwurf, open = offen/fällig, transferred = überwiesen, partially_paid, paid = bezahlt), kind, supplier contact id or supplier name, Belegnummer/description, voucher date range and type (normal or recurring). Filters run in sevDesk; the type is also re-checked here (then rows are scanned, total is left out and filteredLocally is set). Exact amounts. Paged: pass nextOffset as offset while hasMore is true. Use sevdesk_voucher_get for positions, tax rule and booking accounts; find supplier ids with sevdesk_contacts_search.

| Argument       | Type                                                             | Required | Description                                                                    |
| -------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `status`       | `draft` \| `open` \| `transferred` \| `partially_paid` \| `paid` | no       | Voucher status by name.                                                        |
| `kind`         | `expense` \| `revenue`                                           | no       | expense (Ausgabe, creditDebit C) or revenue (Einnahme, creditDebit D).         |
| `supplierId`   | integer                                                          | no       | Contact id of the supplier (Lieferant) or customer.                            |
| `supplierName` | string                                                           | no       | Part of the supplier name, for vouchers without a contact too.                 |
| `description`  | string                                                           | no       | Part of the Belegnummer or description, e.g. an invoice number.                |
| `from`         | string                                                           | no       | First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD (Berlin time).                                |
| `to`           | string                                                           | no       | Last day to include, YYYY-MM-DD (Berlin time).                                 |
| `type`         | `normal` \| `recurring`                                          | no       | normal (VOU) or recurring (RV).                                                |
| `limit`        | integer                                                          | no       | Page size, 1–100. Default: `25`.                                               |
| `offset`       | integer                                                          | no       | Rows to skip, for paging: pass the previous result's nextOffset. Default: `0`. |

## Toolset `banking`

### `sevdesk_bank_accounts_list`

**List sevDesk bank accounts** · tier `read` · read-only, idempotent

List the payment accounts (Zahlungskonten): bank accounts (Bankkonten), clearing accounts (Verrechnungskonten) and cash registers (Kasse), each with its balance (Saldo) at a day, today in Berlin by default. The balance is sevDesk's sum of the transactions it knows, not necessarily the bank's figure. IBANs show only their last four characters. Balances are fetched for at most 25 accounts per call. Use an account id with sevdesk_transactions_list to see its transactions (Umsätze).

| Argument          | Type    | Required | Description                                                         |
| ----------------- | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `balanceDate`     | string  | no       | Balance at the end of this day, YYYY-MM-DD; default today (Berlin). |
| `includeArchived` | boolean | no       | Also list archived (archiviert) accounts. Default: `false`.         |

### `sevdesk_reconcile_suggest`

**Suggest matches for sevDesk bank transactions** · tier `read` · read-only, idempotent

Bank reconciliation (Kontoabgleich, Zuordnung): for unassigned bank transactions (Kontoumsätze, status created, or partly linked with a rest), rank the open invoices (Rechnungen), credit notes (Gutschriften) and vouchers (Belege, by Belegnummer) they most likely pay: exact open amount, document number in the purpose (Verwendungszweck), counterparty name, date; plus split suggestions (several documents adding up exactly). Each match has reasons, a confidence and the exact sevdesk_transaction_book call; book only after the user agrees. Pass transactionId, or checkAccountId and/or a value-date range (page with offset). Imported bank accounts only: offline and cash accounts get their transactions from bookings. Read-only.

| Argument         | Type    | Required | Description                                                                             |
| ---------------- | ------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `transactionId`  | integer | no       | One transaction (Umsatz) id; leave out to scan unassigned ones.                         |
| `checkAccountId` | integer | no       | Payment account (Zahlungskonto) id, from sevdesk_bank_accounts_list.                    |
| `from`           | string  | no       | First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD (Berlin time).                                         |
| `to`             | string  | no       | Last day to include, YYYY-MM-DD (Berlin time).                                          |
| `limit`          | integer | no       | Transactions per call (default 10, at most 25). Default: `10`.                          |
| `offset`         | integer | no       | sevDesk transaction rows to skip: pass nextOffset from the previous call. Default: `0`. |
| `matches`        | integer | no       | Matches per transaction (default 3). Default: `3`.                                      |

### `sevdesk_transaction_book`

**Book a sevDesk bank transaction to documents** · tier `commit` · changes state, destructive, supports `dryRun`, asks the user to confirm

Book (zuordnen) a bank transaction (Kontoumsatz) to documents: invoices (Rechnungen, money in), credit notes (Gutschriften, money out) or vouchers (Belege, by direction). Each allocation books a payment linked to the transaction; amount defaults to the smaller of the open amount and what is left. Up to 10 documents per call (split, e.g. one transfer for several invoices); a partly linked transaction (status 200) is bookable up to its rest. Guards: at most the unassigned amount in total, each at most the document's open amount unless paymentType says otherwise (cash_discount/Skonto, bank_fees, other_difference, reminder_charges: only when one document takes the whole transaction), same direction and currency. Candidates: sevdesk_reconcile_suggest. Commit tier: asks a human to confirm the preview; dryRun only previews. Undo: sevdesk_transaction_reset.

| Argument        | Type     | Required | Description                                                                                                                                              |
| --------------- | -------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `transactionId` | integer  | yes      | Bank transaction (Umsatz) id, from sevdesk_transactions_list.                                                                                            |
| `allocations`   | object[] | yes      | Documents to book the transaction to, in this order.                                                                                                     |
| `dryRun`        | boolean  | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false. |

### `sevdesk_transaction_get`

**Get a sevDesk bank transaction with its assignments** · tier `read` · read-only, idempotent

Show one bank transaction (Kontoumsatz) with its assignments (Zuordnungen): which invoices (Rechnungen), credit notes (Gutschriften) or vouchers (Belege) it was booked to, with how much, and the amount still unassigned (exact; from sevDesk's booking log). Use it before sevdesk_transaction_book (partly linked transactions, status 200, can be booked up to the remaining amount) and before sevdesk_transaction_reset (to see what would be undone). Find ids with sevdesk_transactions_list. Offline and cash accounts get their transactions from payment bookings, so they are booked already. Read-only.

| Argument | Type    | Required | Description                                                   |
| -------- | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`     | integer | yes      | Bank transaction (Umsatz) id, from sevdesk_transactions_list. |

### `sevdesk_transaction_mark_private`

**Mark a sevDesk bank transaction as private** · tier `commit` · changes state, destructive, supports `dryRun`, asks the user to confirm

Mark an unbooked bank transaction (Kontoumsatz, status created) as private: outgoing money becomes a Privatentnahme (owner's withdrawal), incoming a Privateinlage (owner's deposit); it then counts as neither business expense nor income and is not matched to documents. Only for sole proprietors and partnerships (Einzelunternehmen, GbR); a GmbH or UG has no private withdrawals (book a shareholder loan or distribution instead). Commit tier: asks a human to confirm the preview; dryRun only previews. Undo: sevdesk_transaction_reset. Find transactions with sevdesk_transactions_list.

| Argument        | Type    | Required | Description                                                                                                                                              |
| --------------- | ------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `transactionId` | integer | yes      | Bank transaction (Umsatz) id, from sevdesk_transactions_list.                                                                                            |
| `dryRun`        | boolean | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false. |

### `sevdesk_transaction_reset`

**Undo the bookings of a sevDesk bank transaction** · tier `commit` · changes state, destructive, supports `dryRun`, asks the user to confirm

Undo a bank transaction's bookings (Zuordnung aufheben). A private transaction (Privatentnahme/-einlage) becomes unbooked again. A linked or booked one: every document it paid (Rechnung, Gutschrift, Beleg) is reset to open, because sevDesk cannot unlink a single transaction; that removes ALL payments of those documents, also other transactions' and cash bookings, which the preview lists. Refuses enshrined (festgeschrieben) transactions and documents. Check first with sevdesk_transaction_get. Commit tier: asks a human to confirm the preview; dryRun only previews. Afterwards book again with sevdesk_transaction_book.

| Argument        | Type    | Required | Description                                                                                                                                              |
| --------------- | ------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `transactionId` | integer | yes      | Bank transaction (Umsatz) id, from sevdesk_transactions_list.                                                                                            |
| `dryRun`        | boolean | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false. |

### `sevdesk_transactions_list`

**List sevDesk bank transactions** · tier `read` · read-only, idempotent

List bank transactions (Umsätze) of the payment accounts. Amounts are signed: positive = incoming, negative = outgoing (direction in/out). Filter by account id, date range, direction and status: created (offen, not yet booked), linked (verknüpft), private, auto_booked, booked (gebucht). Unbooked = status created. Status, direction and value-date ranges are checked here while reading up to 5000 rows per call; dateField=entry lets sevDesk filter by entry date instead (faster). offset/nextOffset count sevDesk rows, not matches: pass nextOffset while hasMore is true. Account ids: sevdesk_bank_accounts_list.

| Argument         | Type                                                              | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                        |
| ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `checkAccountId` | integer                                                           | no       | Payment account (Zahlungskonto) id.                                                                                                                                |
| `from`           | string                                                            | no       | First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD (Berlin time).                                                                                                                    |
| `to`             | string                                                            | no       | Last day to include, YYYY-MM-DD (Berlin time).                                                                                                                     |
| `dateField`      | `value` \| `entry`                                                | no       | Date that from/to apply to: value (Wertstellung, default; filtered here) or entry (the second date, see entryDate; sevDesk filters it itself). Default: `"value"`. |
| `status`         | `created` \| `linked` \| `private` \| `auto_booked` \| `booked`[] | no       | Statuses to include, e.g. ['created'] for unbooked transactions.                                                                                                   |
| `direction`      | `in` \| `out`                                                     | no       | in = incoming (positive), out = outgoing (negative).                                                                                                               |
| `limit`          | integer                                                           | no       | Page size, 1–100. Default: `25`.                                                                                                                                   |
| `offset`         | integer                                                           | no       | Rows to skip, for paging: pass the previous result's nextOffset. Default: `0`.                                                                                     |

## Toolset `parts`

### `sevdesk_part_create`

**Create a sevDesk part** · tier `write` · changes state, supports `dryRun`

Create a part (Artikel anlegen) for invoice and offer positions: name, Artikelnummer (required, must be free), sales price net or gross (the other is computed with the tax rate and rounded to cents), tax rate (default 19), unit (default 1 = Stk), purchase price, stock and stock tracking (Lagerbestand), description and internal note. Tier write. Check existing parts with sevdesk_parts_list first; change the part later with sevdesk_part_update.

| ----------------- | ---------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`            | string           | yes      | Part name (Artikelname) as printed on documents.                                                                                                         |
| `partNumber`      | string           | yes      | Artikelnummer; must not be used by another part.                                                                                                         |
| `price`           | string \| number | no       | Sales price (Verkaufspreis) in EUR, net or gross per priceType; the other one is computed with the tax rate.                                             |
| `priceType`       | `net` \| `gross` | no       | Whether price is the net (netto, default) or gross (brutto) price. Default: `"net"`.                                                                     |
| `taxRate`         | string \| number | no       | Tax rate in percent, default 19.                                                                                                                         |
| `unitId`          | integer          | no       | Unit (Einheit) id, see sevdesk_reference_lookup kind=units (1 = Stk). Default: `1`.                                                                      |
| `pricePurchase`   | string \| number | no       | Purchase price (Einkaufspreis), net, EUR.                                                                                                                |
| `stock`           | string \| number | no       | Stock (Bestand).                                                                                                                                         |
| `stockEnabled`    | boolean          | no       | Track stock (Lagerbestand) for the part. Default: `false`.                                                                                               |
| `description`     | string           | no       | Description (Beschreibung) printed on documents.                                                                                                         |
| `internalComment` | string           | no       | Internal note, not printed.                                                                                                                              |
| `dryRun`          | boolean          | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false. |

### `sevdesk_part_get`

**Get a sevDesk part** · tier `read` · read-only, idempotent

Get one part (Artikel) by its sevDesk id: Artikelnummer, name, description (Beschreibung), unit, prices, tax rate, internal note and stock (Bestand), including the current stock from sevDesk's stock endpoint when stock tracking (Lagerbestand) is on. Use it after sevdesk_parts_list. Unit ids resolve with sevdesk_reference_lookup kind=units.

| Argument | Type    | Required | Description                            |
| -------- | ------- | -------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `id`     | integer | yes      | Part id, e.g. from sevdesk_parts_list. |

### `sevdesk_part_update`

**Update a sevDesk part** · tier `write` · changes state, destructive, idempotent, supports `dryRun`

Change a part (Artikel ändern): only the fields you give change, nothing is cleared. Name, Artikelnummer (must be free), sales price net or gross (the other is computed), tax rate (alone: the net price stays, the gross price is recomputed), unit, purchase price, stock, stock tracking, active/inactive, description, internal note. Existing documents keep their prices. Tier write. Reads the part first (sevdesk_part_get shows the current values) and fails when nothing would change.

| `partNumber`      | string           | no       | Artikelnummer; must not be used by another part.                                                                                                         |
| `price`           | string \| number | no       | Sales price (Verkaufspreis) in EUR, net or gross per priceType; the other one is computed with the tax rate.                                             |
| `priceType`       | `net` \| `gross` | no       | Whether price is the net (netto, default) or gross (brutto) price. Default: `"net"`.                                                                     |
| `taxRate`         | string \| number | no       | Tax rate in percent.                                                                                                                                     |
| `unitId`          | integer          | no       | Unit (Einheit) id, see sevdesk_reference_lookup kind=units (1 = Stk).                                                                                    |
| `pricePurchase`   | string \| number | no       | Purchase price (Einkaufspreis), net, EUR.                                                                                                                |
| `stock`           | string \| number | no       | Stock (Bestand).                                                                                                                                         |
| `stockEnabled`    | boolean          | no       | Track stock (Lagerbestand) for the part.                                                                                                                 |
| `active`          | boolean          | no       | false deactivates the part (inactive), true activates it.                                                                                                |
| `description`     | string           | no       | Description (Beschreibung) printed on documents.                                                                                                         |
| `internalComment` | string           | no       | Internal note, not printed.                                                                                                                              |
| `dryRun`          | boolean          | no       | Preview only: check the action and return exactly what it would do, without changing anything in sevDesk and without asking the user. Defaults to false. |

### `sevdesk_parts_list`

**List sevDesk parts** · tier `read` · read-only, idempotent

List parts (Artikel): the products and services of the account with Artikelnummer, name, unit, net and gross sales price, purchase price, tax rate, stock (Bestand) and active flag.
